The `proverb` function has been implemented to generate the proverb from a list of words and an optional `qualifier` keyword argument. For each consecutive pair in the list, it creates a line: "For want of a {X} the {Y} was lost." The final line is "And all for the want of a {qualifier} {first_word}." if a qualifier is provided, otherwise "And all for the want of a {first_word}." The function handles empty lists (returns empty string) and single-word lists (only the final line). The qualifier is inserted as an adjective before the first noun in the final line when it is a non-empty string.

All tests should pass with this implementation.
